checks.text: The page displays the heading "Gradient Generator" and the text "No gradients saved" in the library panel.
Clicking the button "Add stop" adds a new stop to the list; the stop list now contains one item labeled "Stop 1" with a hex value of "#ff0000" and a position of "0%".
With one stop present, typing "50" in the field labeled "Position" for "Stop 1" and pressing Enter updates the position to "50%" and the CSS preview text updates to include "50%".
Clicking the button "Add stop" a second time adds "Stop 2" with a hex value of "#0000ff" and a position of "100%"; the CSS preview now shows two color stops.
Selecting "Radial" in the dropdown labeled "Type" changes the CSS preview from "linear-gradient" to "radial-gradient".
Clicking the button "Copy CSS" copies the current gradient string to the clipboard and displays the toast message "CSS copied".
Typing "Sunset" in the field labeled "Name" and clicking the button "Save gradient" adds an item to the library panel containing "Sunset"; the text "No gradients saved" is removed.
Clicking the button "Delete Sunset" in the library panel removes that item and restores the text "No gradients saved".
Reload keeps the saved gradient "Sunset" in the library panel and the current stop configuration with "Stop 1" at "50%".
